description: Push notification channel on loopback: open, raw and toast delivery, late send, unreachable address; in the browser, where nothing can listen, ErrorOccurred (ChannelOpenFailed) and refused sends
script: goto:dev-notify;wait:20;press:Open the channel;wait:5;press:Send a raw notification;wait:5;press:Send a toast notification;wait:10;press:BindToShellToast;wait:5;press:Close, then send to the closed channel;wait:5;press:Send to an address nobody listens on;wait:5;stats;quit
expectRegex: \[museum\]\[notify\] open: ChannelUriUpdated 1 time\(s\), URI http://127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+/museum-notify-room/, Find this room's channel
expect: [museum][notify] BindToShellToast: IsShellToastBound yes (recorded only: no shell displays it)
[museum][notify] after Close: send refused, queued before Close and raised after it 0, URI null, Find null (no open channel of that name)

replace.[museum][notify] after Close: send refus: [museum][notify] open: ChannelUriUpdated 0 time(s), URI null, Find null (no open channel of that name)

replaceRegex.\\[museum\\]\\[notify\\] open: ChannelUr: \[museum\]\[notify\] ErrorOccurred: ChannelOpenFailed, code -?[0-9]+: HttpNotificationChannel: listener setup failed
